name: Vepley

skills.name: Live Interaction
skills.description: Select 1 enemy target within 5 tiles and deal Physical damage equal to 80% of attack to it.

skills.name: All Out Performance
skills.description: Selects 1 direction, dealing Physical damage equal to 75% of attack to the first enemy target in each line within a 3x5 area in the selected direction, and knocks the target back by 4 tiles. Simultaneously, destroys any destructible Cover outside the 3x3 tile area around the user.

skills.name: Exclusive Stage
skills.description: Selects 1 enemy target within 5 tiles and deal Physical damage equal to 150% of attack to it. If the target has movement debuffs, ignore 10% of Cover damage reduction. If the target is not protected by Cover, dispels 2 of its buffs before attacking.

skills.name: Infectious Enthusiasm
skills.description: Selects 1 tile within 5 tiles to attack, dealing AoE Physical damage equal to 100% of attack to all enemy targets within 2 tiles. Additionally, this applies Overzealous and Vulnerable II to the targets for 2 turns.

skills.name: Idol Talent
skills.description: At the start of the action, gains 1 point of Confectance Index. For each instance of damage dealt, gains 1 point of Confectance Index. Damage dealt to targets with movement debuffs is increased by 20%. If this unit moved 5 or more tiles, applies Movement Down II to the target for 2 turns before attacking.

fortification.effect: If 2 or more targets are hit, gain 3 tiles of  Additional Movement.
If the target has movement debuffs, increase critical rate by 100%.
Overzealous is now applied before the attack instead of after.
If this unit moved 3 or more tiles, applies Movement Down II to the target before attacking.
If the target has movement debuffs, applies Movement Denied to them for 1 turn.
If only 1 target is hit, applies Stun for 1 turn.

keys.name: Fixed Key 1 - Safe Distance Viewing
keys.effect: Increases Stability Damage dealt against enemy targets with movement debuffs by 2 points.

keys.name: Fixed Key 2 - Contamination Zone Tour
keys.effect: The range of All Out Performance changes to 5x3 tiles, knockback distance changes to 1 tile.

keys.name: Fixed Key 3 - Fortune of an Idol
keys.effect: If there are no allied units within 6 tiles of the user, gain 1 stack of Quick Barrier at the end of the action.

keys.name: Fixed Key 4 - Dino Dash
keys.effect: When using Exclusive Stage, ignores 10% of Cover damage reduction against targets with movement debuffs.

keys.name: Fixed Key 5 - Stress Resistance Training
keys.effect: If there is Cover nearby, reduces AoE damage taken by 20%.

keys.name: Fixed Key 6 - Stage Commitment
keys.effect: When applying a movement debuff to a large target, additionally deals 1 instance of fixed damage equal to 15% of attack.

keys.name: Common Key - Heart Melting Strike
keys.effect: ATK +5.0% / If the user's Mobility is greater than or equal to the target's, increases damage dealt by 7%.

keys.name: Expansion Key
keys.effect:
Attacks ignore 15% of the target's DEF, if the target has movement debuffs, further ignores 15% DEF

All Out Performance: Applies Stun and Vulnerable II to targets for 2 turns
